model.Peephole.IS.ICmp.Ext: analyses the core Oracle lacks: isImpliedByDomCondition (domCond), getRange (getRange) and computeConstantRange (constRange), with Ext.Sound. The entry point simplifyICmpInst.onInst runs with Ext.none, which knows nothing; simplifyICmpInst.onInstWith takes any Ext, and simplifyICmpInst.sound holds for every sound one
model.Peephole.IS.ICmp.CR: ConstantRange as ConstantRange.cpp computes it (makeAllowedICmpRegion, makeExactICmpRegion, contains, inverse, icmp and the min and max of a range), with what each says about values proved; the steps that read a range only fire at a positive width, since LLVM has no i0 and at width 0 the full and the empty range are the same pair
model.Peephole.IS.simplifyICmpInst.body: simplifyICmpInst's own recursive calls (on the operands of two zexts or two sexts, on a zext or sext against a constant that's an extension, and on sext X against 0) are forwards to the model one MaxRecurse down; simplifyICmpInst.sound covers them by induction. Those on two extensions, or on one and an extended constant, are only taken where the cast widens (v < w), as LLVM's verifier requires and Term doesn't. body3 is body at RecursionLimit written out without recursion (body_three: they're equal by rfl), which the entry point runs, so the comparison with opt can name each case's site
model.Peephole.IS.simplifyUnsignedRangeCheck: the source is ICmp.andOrSrc, the and (IsAnd) or the or of ZeroICmp and UnsignedICmp with any flags; sound_swap has them the other way round, as simplifyAndOfICmps' and simplifyOrOfICmps' second call needs
